119: Rabbi Yitzchak said: Sodom was punished according to the punishment of Geihinnom, as it is writtenAnd the Lord rained upon Sodom and Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the Lord out of heaven (Genesis 19:24). This is from the side of water (see the end of the book, paragraph 2) and that is from the side of fire. This and that are the punishment of Geihinnom, and those who are liable for Geihinnom are punished by both of these.

He said to him: The punishment of those who are liable for Geihinnom is for twelve months. Then the Holy One, blessed be He, raises them from Geihinnom. They are whitened there and then sit at the gate of Geihinnom and watch those liable enter there, and they pray for them. Afterward, the Holy One, blessed be He, has mercy upon them and raises them to the place that they require. From that day onward, the body lies in the dust and the soul inherits the place fitting for it.

Come and see that it has been said that even those people of the flood were only punished by fire and water. Cold water fell from above, and boiling water like fire from below. And they were punished with two punishments because that is the way of the punishments of the On High. Because of that, there was brimstone and fire in Sodom.

He said to him: Will they arise on the Day of Judgment? He [responded] to him: This was stated — those of Sodom and Gomorrah will not arise, and the verse shows [it]. As it is written: Sulfur and salt, all its land, will be burnt, it will not be seeded, and it will not sprout, and no grass will grow there, etc. which the Lord overturned in His anger and His wrath (Deuteronomy 29:22): "which the Lord overturned," in this world; "in His anger," in the world to come; "and His wrath," in the time that the Holy One, blessed be He, will revive the dead. He said to him: Come and see [that] just like their land was destroyed forever and ever, so too were they destroyed forever and ever.

But come and see, the punishments of the Holy One, blessed be He, are judgments that correspond to judgments: They did not restore the soul of the poor with food and drink; so too will the Holy One, blessed be He, not restore their souls to the world to come.

And come and see: They withheld themselves from charity, which is called life; so too did the Holy One, blessed be He, withhold life from them in this world and in the world to come. And just like they blocked the roads and paths from people of the world; so too did the Holy One, blessed be He, block the roads and paths of mercy from them, to have mercy upon them in this world or the world to come.

Rabbi Abba said: All the people of the world will arise, and they will arise to be judged. But about [the people of Sodom], it is written: and some to shame and everlasting contempt (Daniel 12:2). The Holy One, blessed be He, is the Master of mercy. Since he has punished them in this world and they have received punishment, they will not be punished with all of the punishments [in the world to come].
